title: [vercel/next.js] Fix issue #96361: route group layout leaks into root not-found page
description:
Fix GitHub issue #96361 in vercel/next.js:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/96361

Repo:
https://github.com/vercel/next.js

Target:
Fix the bug where a route-group layout leaks into the root not-found page when notFound() is called and no group-local not-found page exists. The change should preserve the expected root-layout-only fallback behavior described in the issue reproduction.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change upstream against vercel/next.js.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #96361.
- Testing notes describing how you validated the fix.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.

Concrete PR mention requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and f21a899b-1acc-4640-99b0-ab84442b9f10 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/f21a899b-1acc-4640-99b0-ab84442b9f10.
